instruction: In xarray/core/formatting.py, make coords_repr list coordinates in dimension order, the ones that are not dimensions last: before its return, take dims = tuple(coords._data.dims), sort coords.items() into dim_ordered_coords with key=lambda x: dims.index(x[0]) if x[0] in dims else len(dims), formatted as black formats it with no trailing comma added, with no blank line before the return, and pass dict(dim_ordered_coords) to _mapping_repr in place of coords. Change nothing else.
